It is up about 590% over 6h and about 100% over 1h, near its all-time high (2.42e-5 vs 2.71e-5). Volume is about $52k, with 400 unique buyers and 294 unique sellers. It has a product-style pitch ("trade what X is talking about", live cashtag indexes), a website, an X account, a DexScreener profile and a 3.4% Streamflow vesting lock. It also carries a GMGN community-takeover flag, and GMGN tags 79 bundler wallets among its 138 holders. The most recent GeckoTerminal 5-minute window shows buying stalling: 2 buyers vs 4 sellers, price -5%.

authenticity.evidence: Organic-looking signs: 400 unique buyers in 6h, a reasonably spread top-10 (20.8%), the creator holding only 0.31%, no insider networks, mint and freeze authority renounced, and no paid DexScreener boosts. Red flags: GMGN tags 79 bundler wallets and 83 fresh wallets among 138 holders, and the bot/degen rate is 42%. The linked X account has launched 5 tokens, and dead same-name launches sit alongside this one. The community-takeover flag is odd for a coin whose own dev is active.
authenticity.uncertainty: The bundler tag count is high, but the top bundler holding is only 8.5%. I can't tell whether the bundles belong to the team or are just bot noise. I have no X data to judge real attention.
